title: The installation takes on a new job
lede: Rehearsal of 20 October 2026. A simulated robot installation with one robot policy that never changes, and agents that improve the installation around it. Story A: two investigations of one job, neither released, each with its account; story B: an engagement on a robot fleet and the reuse of its probe recipe. The record page is written from the demo's runs and is not part of this build yet.
